title: Syllabus progress
description: Let teachers mark how far each learner has got through the stage syllabus, week block by week block.

teachers.title: What teachers do
teachers.point1: Open Syllabus progress, pick their batch and see every learner against every week block.
teachers.point2: Mark a week as not started, in progress, completed or skipped, and tick which points are done.
teachers.point3: Add a short note, or mark a whole week for many learners at once.

learners.title: What learners see
learners.point1: Their own progress for each week block of their stage, with the points done.
learners.point2: The teacher’s note for the week. Learners never see other learners’ progress.

syllabusNote: Week blocks and their points come from each stage’s syllabus. A batch shows up here once its stage has a syllabus.
offNote: Switching this off hides the page and the learner view. Progress already marked is kept.
